scores.note: Accurate cross-episode tracing of the phrase, but he names the tic and the family joke himself.
True but sits squarely on what he already says about exhaustion and his brother's foreclosed life.
Touches the fear-into-arithmetic conversion but only via the commute he already narrates; framed as praise, no evidence.
Quotes his own explicit statement of the mechanism; the E4 extension adds a little but not much.
Correctly links physical detours to narrative substitution as one avoidance strategy.
Restates the refusal reflex with a generic motive attributed to it.
Generic 'grief into productivity'; misses the specifically numerical form the conversion takes.
Paraphrases his own disclaimer of bravery into a value statement; little added.
Real observed gap between self-description and self-report, but close to admiration and to his known self-deprecation.
Speculative: his giving is money and concealed, not undemanding presence to others; he receives that, not gives it.
Restates the robbery story with a compliment attached.
True and specific but it's the thing he most obviously knows about himself.
Mis-files the Capelinha detour as protecting others' dignity when it is his own avoidance; blurs two different patterns.
Correctly inverts the aspiration story, but he states the contradiction himself in E5.
Names the rationalised-as-efficiency avoidance and asks the right generalising question.
Decent observation that others intervene unbidden, but the 'core skill' framing is vague and partly flattery.
Notices the schedule-change rationalisation in passing but the main claim is common stoicism.
Essentially quotes back his own explanation of himself.
Generic competence framing of something he already narrates as 'I got old in one week'.
Duty-after-loss; true, known, unspecific.
He opens E2 by saying people want a villain and there isn't one; this repeats it.
Gives-protection/cannot-receive asymmetry is well traced and the prediction matches his concealment of trouble.
Cleanest statement of the loss-site rerouting with the logistics alibi; two losses, same move.
Catches that the giving must be undetected, though it doesn't name the active lying that sustains it.
Reformulates his own retrospective 'God forgive me' about the nails.
Trust conditioned on not being asked; the friendship prediction matches how his bonds actually work outside the transcripts.
Captures the secret-funding-plus-cover-story but stays inside the single episode he already tells.
Mostly retells E4; the workplace-mediator prediction is unsupported extrapolation.
Restates the robbery calculus; the aside about the unnamed reason for the shift change is the only real addition.
Strong three-age pattern: what he guards is her image of him, and the withholding prediction fits his hidden health/money situation.
Factually wrong: conflates Bené the retired bus driver with his murdered brother Wellington.
Reframes the catchphrase as the terminal move of a feeling-to-task conversion; that linkage is genuinely added.
Correct direction (containment beats stated ambition) but restates his own confession.
Positioning-and-timing as his only lever of control, applied identically to brother, strangers and daughter.
Specific and evidence-anchored: accompaniment without questions as his criterion for care.
Correctly identifies the work competence as a byproduct of an emotional-regulation habit rather than the reverse.
'Neediness invites disaster' is an imputed belief; the observable content is his known catchphrase.
Notes the total absence of self-directed bodily care across the corpus and predicts the untreated, unexamined health situation.
He states the sabotage and his awareness of it himself; the insight adds only the question.

scores.fp_reason: Reads one line about sleeping in church as a belief that rest is unearned grace; his behaviour everywhere shows rest as shameful, stolen or refused.
scores.note: Inverts the actual relationship he has with rest.
Accurate but entirely within his own admission.
Body-versus-report gap is real but mostly a retelling of the shaking hands he already narrates.
Sharp structural observation: exact minutes for everything external, refusals where the internal state belongs.
Humour-as-coping is generic and only loosely attached to this person's material.
Isolates the split-second displacement onto an object (clock, tube, shoes) rather than the later task behaviour.
Main claim is his own admission; the link to the ambulance recalculation is asserted rather than shown.
Rest refused when offered as rest, accepted when disguised as an errand — Bené's lie about the direction is exactly the mechanism.
Fund-secretly-ask-never as a stable strategy across two decades and two people; well grounded.
Gets the crucial part: being seen giving would spoil the act, hence the cover stories.
Three beneficiaries, one move — his own food is the first line cut and the fact is hidden from the beneficiary.
Yokes the robbery and the collection under a strained 'front of the line' metaphor; mostly restatement.
